framework.description: Build-time and runtime framework primitives without provider or transport implementations.

protocols.description: Protocol contracts and generated protocol artifacts.

desktop-contracts.description: Browser-safe desktop contract declarations and schema compiler inputs.

transports.description: Protocol transports that execute application surfaces independently from deployment hosts.

hosts.description: Runtime lifecycle adapters for Node processes, Lambda invocations, and Cloudflare Workers fetch events.

build-targets.description: Build-time entrypoint, output, format, and bundling contracts without runtime lifecycle ownership.

integrations.description: Concrete datastore, SaaS provider, and external service adapters.

app.description: Repository-owned CLIs, scaffolds, docs, and release tooling.

packageCatalogGroupOverrides.reason: events-tx binds event contracts to transaction infrastructure, so architecture policy treats it as an adapter boundary.
telemetry-api is the application-facing telemetry contract consumed by framework/core packages; telemetry-sdk-node remains the runtime integration.
tx-drizzle is the Drizzle transaction implementation even though the package catalog keeps transaction packages in Core.
protocols-desktop is a browser-safe contract/compiler boundary with stricter runtime and dependency limits than general protocol packages.

forbiddenImports.description: Framework and core packages must not depend on concrete provider/runtime implementation packages.
forbiddenImports.message: Framework/core packages cannot import provider or runtime implementation packages.
forbiddenImports.recovery: Move provider/runtime implementation code behind an adapter package and keep the framework/core package on an explicit contract.

forbiddenImports.description: Framework and core packages must not depend on concrete provider/runtime SDKs.
forbiddenImports.message: Framework/core packages cannot import provider or runtime implementation SDKs.
forbiddenImports.recovery: Move provider/runtime implementation code behind an adapter package and keep the framework/core package on an explicit contract.

forbiddenImports.description: Desktop protocol contracts must remain independent of Electron, Node, and Electron transport runtimes.
forbiddenImports.message: Desktop protocol contracts cannot import Electron, Node runtime APIs, or Electron transports.
forbiddenImports.recovery: Move runtime integration behind an Electron transport package and keep protocols-desktop browser-safe.

forbiddenImports.description: Desktop protocol contracts must not import application bootstrap packages.
forbiddenImports.message: Desktop protocol contracts cannot import application bootstrap packages.
forbiddenImports.recovery: Keep application composition outside protocols-desktop and depend only on declared contract packages.

allowedGroupImports.message: Desktop protocol package manifests may depend only on contract libraries and declared test/schema tooling.
allowedGroupImports.recovery: Keep protocols-desktop dependencies limited to @croco/problems-core, @croco/protocols-core, vitest, and zod.

publicEntrypoints.description: Production source imports between Croco packages must use declared package exports instead of src/dist internals.
publicEntrypoints.message: Croco packages must import declared public entrypoints instead of private package internals.
publicEntrypoints.recovery: Export the needed surface from the target package or move the test-only alias behind an explicit test/config ignore.
